President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. ordered a one-month suspension in the planned full rehabilitation of EDSA, citing the heavy traffic burden it would impose on hundreds of thousands of commuters and motorists using the 23-km. EDSA.

Marcos instructed his team to evaluate newer methods and innovations that could potentially cut the project timeline.
